name: Maestro enforcer leader
description: A dark-haired Maestro enforcer who leads four attackers against Elspeth and shoots sparks from his fingers; unnamed on this page.

timeline.summary: Elspeth hears the shopkeeper being beaten over a debt and intervenes against four Maestro enforcers.
timeline.quote: "Anyone who finds sadistic pleasure in beating up an unarmed man makes themselves my business."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth leads the Maestro enforcers on a chase through the Mezzio and ends up cornered at a half-built bridge.
timeline.quote: The road she'd been running down ended abruptly, a half-finished bridge extending out into empty air.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth grabs a steel rod and knocks out all four enforcers without killing them.
timeline.quote: rendered him unconscious with a thud
